name: Station
description: Open-source research environment where AI agents run experiments, collaborate and build a shared scientific literature

name: ReevesAgents
description: Local workspace that runs coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Kimi, Qwen, Hermes, Aider, and others) side by side in tmux, driven from a TUI, a loopback-only Web UI, or the CLI, with an opt-in stdio MCP server that lets one agent spawn, read, steer, and stop the others

name: CUGA
description: IBM Research's generalist agent harness built on LangGraph; executes tasks over APIs (OpenAPI specs, MCP servers, LangChain tools), the web (Playwright), or both, with policy-based guardrails and human-in-the-loop approval (Intent Guard, Playbook, Tool Approval), multi-agent supervision including remote A2A agents, and agent skills

name: cloneproof
description: Measures how closely an agent-built website clone matches the original and returns per-element differences plus a fix prompt for the agent's next iteration

name: Weave Router
description: Open-source Go proxy for the Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions and Gemini APIs that picks a model per request with an on-box embedder, for Claude Code, Codex, opencode and pi

name: AgentStackWatch
description: Nightly-updated tracker of about 43 personal agents, agent frameworks and managed agent platforms, with sourced release notes, breaking changes, side-by-side comparisons and a weekly digest

name: awesome-ai-agents
description: Curated list of AI agent frameworks, coding agents, browser agents, tools, platforms and research, grouped by category

name: **Ralph Loop Model Benchmark (Roboco)**
description: · Benchmark | Compare 22 model and harness combinations (Claude Code, Codex CLI, pi, Antigravity CLI) on finishing a RealWorld backend without human help, by completion, time, tokens and estimated cost; single task, mostly 3 runs per condition; EN/KO/JA/ZH | Free reading, no signup; no license stated | 2026-10-20 |

name: **Language Benchmark (Roboco)**
description: · Benchmark | Choose a backend language for vibe coding: Claude Code builds the same RealWorld backend in 10 languages, scored on 24 metrics for build cost, runtime performance and maintenance; figures are relative; EN/KO/JA/ZH | Free reading, no signup; no license stated | 2026-10-20 |

name: Dynamic Document API
description: Turn data into pixel-perfect PDFs and images

name: MergeMe
description: MergeMe brings GitHub/GitLab PRs/MRs directly into Slack as 1 constantly updating card

name: opengeocoding.com
description: Source-available geocoder in Rust: address search, autocomplete and reverse geocoding on open data

name: Mails.ai
description: Email inboxes for automated tests: a plus address per test and one call that waits for the email and returns the sign-up code or magic link, with TypeScript and Python SDKs, Cypress and Playwright packages and an MCP server
